name: Punch'Em Up
author: Louis Pearson
description: A tiny, unfinished beat 'em up made for the WASM-4 jam: take on the enemies with your fists and, above all, have fun punching the pots!

descriptions.en: A tiny, unfinished beat 'em up made for the WASM-4 jam: take on the enemies with your fists and, above all, have fun punching the pots!
descriptions.it: Un piccolo picchiaduro incompiuto creato per la jam di WASM-4: affronta i nemici a suon di pugni e, soprattutto, divertiti a prendere a pugni i vasi!
